'''Thexan''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the son of [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Tenebrae]], who possessed the body of [[Valkorion]], the "Immortal Emperor" of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was the twin brother of [[Arcann]], with whom he led a series of [[Eternal Empire raids|raids]] against the worlds of the larger galaxy. After they fought many battles on the Eternal Empire's behalf, Arcann became furious at the indifference of Valkorion and attempted to kill him, only for Thexan to intervene and be struck down by Arcann's lightsaber.

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:Thexan1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Thexan as a child]]
Thexan and his twin brother [[Arcann]] were sons of [[Valkorion]], the "Immortal Emperor" of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], and [[Senya Tirall]], a member of Valkorion's elite guard from the ranks of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. As children, Arcann and Thexan would often swap clothes to confuse their servants. Senya loved the twins but they did not return her affections, even after their sister [[Vaylin]] was born. The children ignored their mother, and their father ignored them in turn when they were. The children played together, sparring in the shadow of the [[Eternal Fleet]] or running away and living in the [[Endless Swamp]] for a month. The twins were trained from childhood to be warriors, with Thexan always being there in harsh times. Arcann gradually became resentful of their father's apparent lack of interest or affection towards them, despite Thexan's attempts to placate him. When Senya attempted to leave Valkorion and take her children, Arcann and Thexan simply laughed, calling her weak.<ref name="KOTFE 7">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=7}}</ref>

[[File:Young_Arcann_and_Thexan.png|thumb|250px|right|Thexan and Arcann playing together]]
When Vaylin began displaying growing power and mental instability, Valkorion locked her away on [[Nathema]] to contain her powers. Thexan would make regular visits to her, the only one of their family to do so, bringing her gifts from conquered worlds. He resented the planet being a void in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as much as his sister did.<ref name="KOTET 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=4}}</ref> Years later, Valkorion allowed Vaylin to return home to Zakuul. Vaylin entered the [[Eternal Throne]] where her father sat with Arcann and Thexan at his side. Valkorion presented Vaylin with her first [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Arcann and Thexan moved to defend their father when she ignited her blade, only to to stay their hands at his command. To their relief, Vaylin deactivated the blade and knelt down before Valkorion to pledge her allegiance.<ref name="KOTETChapter7">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref>

===Galactic conquest===
[[File:Thexan_on_Korriban.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Thexan looks after his brother's injuries on Korriban.]]
By [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Arcann and Thexan requested their father's permission to lead an attack to test the strength of the galactic powers of the greater galaxy. Valkorion approved their venture, but decreed that only Thexan would lead the Eternal Fleet, ordering Arcann to remain on Zakuul. Arcann disobeyed his father's wishes and joined his brother anyway. They fought on many worlds, driving back the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], before finally striking at Korriban. They clashed with the Sith under the command of [[Darth Atroxa]] in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. During the battle, Arcann was grievously wounded in an explosion that took his arm and left the left side of his face scarred; Thexan was by his brother's side after the injury. Soon after the attack on Korriban, Thexan was to report to his father on the status of the invasion.<ref name="Brothers" />

[[File:Arcann_kills_Thexan.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Arcann kills Thexan.]]
Returning to Zakuul, Arcann and Thexan presented the lightsabers of the fallen Jedi and Sith as trophies from the battle to their father. However, Valkorion turned away in silence, and overcome by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Arcann became furious and attempted to attack the Emperor. Thexan, in an attempt to prevent his father's death, [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulled]] his brother back. Arcann turned his attention to Thexan and struck out at him, but their brief duel ended when Arcann struck his brother down with a cut across the stomach, and the glint of the dark side faded from his eyes while he cradled Thexan. After his brother's passing, Valkorion instructed Arcann, now his only son, to come with him.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

===Legacy===
[[File:ARIES_impersonates_Thexan.jpg|thumb|200px|left|ARIES impersonates Thexan.]]
A funeral was later held saying that he was killed in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The truth of his death remained unknown to everyone, including Senya, for five years, until Vaylin told her the truth during the [[Battle of Asylum]]. Becoming an Emperor after his father's [[Assassination of Valkorion|assassination]], Arcann remarked that Thexan should be alive, ruling the Empire alongside his brother and sister as it was meant to be ruled. Vaylin agreed that she would like having Thexan back with them.<ref name="Chapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref> 

[[ARIES]] used Holographic disguise to impersonate Thexan on [[Iokath]] while talking to Vaylin, complimenting her strength while subtly probing her for information. Seeing her brother shocked Vaylin, but she instantly became suspicious when she could not feel him through the Force. Vaylin asked about the time Thexan came to Nathema to bring her home, confirming the trickery after she was not corrected, as it was Arcann who did that.<ref name="KOTET 4" />

[[File:Tenebrae_and_Thexan.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Thexan and Tenebrae, the true face of his father.]]
After Valkorion's original body was destroyed, it released a [[Tenebrae's curse|plague]] that infected [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and her [[Satele Shan's followers|followers]], putting then in a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]] trance. The plague would eventually spawn an entity by feeding on the victims.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|The Lingering Darkness|Odessen}}</ref> Arcann and Senya were among those who [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|entered]] Satele's mind to stop the plague, discovering that the plague's entity was the mental imprint of the Tenebrae from before he knew any of them. When they met Vaylin and Thexan, Arcann was shocked to see his brother again. Joining the others victims of Tenebrae, the family helped destroy his mental imprint, putting an end to any chance of his return.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Thexan first appeared in [[Sacrifice (cinematic trailer)|''Sacrifice'']], a cinematic trailer produced by [[Blur Studio]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} fifth digital expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']]. The trailer was released at the Electronic Entertainment Expo on [[June 15]], in [[2015]]. While not named in dialogue, Thexan's name can be seen in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on his crib at the beginning of the trailer. He is voiced by [[Erik Todd Dellums]], who also voiced his twin brother, [[Arcann]].
